assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: illustrated game shop art master for Eredità, to be cut into independently interactive vector-masked objects. The most recent user image is the edit target and layout reference. Preserve its exact overall composition, shop architecture and positions/proportions of ALL merchandise: animals on the left (dog collar hanging, boar head plaque, cow, goat, pig and donkey WITH ITS ENTIRE HEAD AND EARS VISIBLE), three crossed tool sets at center top, three armor pieces at center middle, net on the upper right, wooden hunting cage and steel trap on the right shelf, rowboat on bottom right, six resource baskets (wheat, chestnuts, grapes, meat, fish, milk) across bottom center. Adapt only the art treatment to Eredità's existing earthy medieval Corsican strategy-game art: handsome stylized 3D/painterly materials, muted warm ochre limestone, aged dark walnut, bronze and parchment gold accents, olive foliage, restrained terracotta, soft ambient occlusion, convincing relief, warm sun from upper left. Less shiny orange/plastic than the reference; refined tactile wood, stone, leather and metal. Keep all silhouettes clear and separated for later masking. IMPORTANT remove ALL text, ALL numbers, ALL labels/plaques, ALL prices and UI, including the six baskets' little sale buttons, leaving plain wicker basket fronts. Keep a simple dark wooden band in the top 8% where HTML UI will be overlaid; no title, icons or buttons there. No characters, shopkeeper or new products added. No logo or watermark. The composition remains wide 16:9 and nearly frontal, like the reference. Keep the donkey's face unobscured. This is an art master, NOT a UI mockup: no text anywhere.
